narrator.style: A deep, intense American movie-trailer narrator for an anime thriller: urgent, tense and completely serious, as if a bomb were about to go off, at a quick pace. A short dramatic pause at every '...'. In 'Hold it... three... two... one...' he slows down, low and tense, one number at a time. 'Streak saved. Thirty days.' is a proud, relieved release. The last two lines are friendly and clear, like the end of an ad

lines.text: Eleven fifty-five PM. Leo is on a twenty-nine day streak...
